audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; other fields were shared templates.
audit.why: Lint flag plus quality bar require concrete cooldown numbers.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites Dark Binding's 10s cooldown and Black Shield's 26-16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Morgana's sustain (Soul Siphon, Tormented Shadow) never got an anti-heal timing call.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags Grievous Wounds timing as unstated for this matchup.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Dark Binding (Q) is a flat 10s cooldown — a whiff means 10 clean seconds to step up; minion-block it whenever you can. - Black Shield (E) is 26s down to 16s and voids your charm outright on whoever holds it — force it out before you commit. - Soul Siphon (P) sustains her through chip; anti-heal decides extended trades.

edits.before: Level 2-3 windows govern; level 6 hardens the playbook; first item funds it.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 her 10s-cooldown Dark Binding punishes every telegraphed dash; level 6 Black Shield voids a solo charm; first item's zoning keeps you from setting flanks freely.

edits.before: Zone with the threat — the button you hold governs more than the one you press.
edits.after: Dark Binding is a flat 10s root that punishes any telegraphed W dash — bait it with movement before you commit, since a landed Q means you eat the follow-up, not her.

edits.before: Window economy: convert the ganks, start the rivers, peel the picks.
edits.after: Force Black Shield off the priority target before you charm — a pre-cast shield on whoever you commit to voids your entire engage for free.

edits.before: Carry by windows — one clean play per fight; your carry does the arithmetic.
edits.after: Carry by baiting the shield onto the wrong ally, then charming the real target — Black Shield only protects one person per 26-16s cooldown.

edits.before: You decide the fights your team attends — start them, peel them, or poke them out of existence.
edits.after: Bait Black Shield early — once it's spent, Dark Binding is your only remaining threat to respect, and your charm chain converts cleanly.

edits.before: Ahead, dance louder: entrance Morgana's carry off every window and charm the recovery formations.
edits.after: Ahead, force Black Shield onto the wrong target first, then charm the real one — it's a single-target answer on a 26-16s cooldown.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Bait Black Shield with a feint before your real engage — it only protects one ally and Morgana can't recast it for 26-16s.

edits.before: That is Morgana’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Chip-trading into her Soul Siphon sustain without anti-heal — she out-heals poke damage on her own passive alone.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Charming into an up Black Shield — it voids your CC on that target outright, so bait it out first or pick a different body.
